title: Base change of a closed immersion is a closed immersion
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion] and $g:X'\to X$ any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Then the projection $Z\times_XX'\to X'$ from the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] is a closed immersion.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: the instance `MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange @IsClosedImmersion` (line 382) applied to the pullback square of $i$ along $g$ (`MorphismProperty.pullback_snd`) gives that `pullback.snd i g : pullback i g ⟶ X'` is a closed immersion
